topic: Accepted risk: the hook finds its files through the environment
detail: From the SP-041 security audit (medium, accepted 2026-11-12 with reason): orch-hook locates the guard's files and orch.db through ORCH_DATA_DIR, XDG_DATA_HOME and HOME, which a session can change for a harness it starts inside itself; that nested harness's hook can then read an empty or forged directory and allow every call. Accepted because the same nested harness can already drop every hook (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, --settings), so this adds no new way around the guard; the OS sandbox (SP-046) is the boundary. Proposed for SP-042: refuse tool calls that start a harness with ORCH_DATA_DIR, XDG_DATA_HOME, HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or CODEX_HOME set, or a --settings override. Confirm or ask for a fix in SP-041.
